correctness.rationale: PASS: Checked the exact first-Hermite Bargmann operator (∂_w−conj(w))(w^m+c w^k) factorization. For any nonzero zero s cannot equal k or m; modulus and phase equations give exactly d equally spaced roots for each R(s)=c. Direct differentiation shows R increasing on (0,k) and (m,∞) and middle derivative sign determined by quadratic P(s)=−s²+(m+k−2)s−mk with discriminant (d−2)^2−8k. This analytically proves all three/four/five-polygon counts (not extrapolated from finite tests), fold endpoints, and exceptional equality family (k,m)=(2t²,2(t+1)²). Independently computed m6,k1 folds s=2,3, amplitudes 2^(9/2) and 3^(7/2)/2 and equality m8,k2 s*=4. Polar Jacobian J_G=2dc s^(k−1)(s−k)^2 R'(s) gives alternating ± charges; origin index k−1 plus signed polygon sum d gives m−1. Strict extrema with nonzero angular derivative yield folds; double critical point gives cubic radial crossing and local index −1. Excludes c=0 correctly because then a whole zero circle appears.
